canonical_interaction_contract.alpha_cancellation: All three new canonical coefficients are independent of alpha at fixed s.
canonical_interaction_contract.new_quartic_amplitude: L4_new contains e4c chi^2(d_t chi)^2/Mpl^2 with e4c=2(1-2s)/s=e3c^2
canonical_interaction_contract.new_quartic_mixed: L4_new contains -emix chi(d_parallel chi)(d_t chi)^2/(Mpl Lambda0^2) with emix=1/[s^2(1-s)]
canonical_interaction_contract.normalization: Use c_perp^2=(1-2s)/[2(1-s)], d^2x_perp=c_perp^2 d^2Xperp, and chi=sqrt(2C) pi exactly as in the bound derivative-leading package.
canonical_interaction_contract.sign_scope: The displayed signs follow the declared positive-background-gradient orientation; the coefficient scales use magnitudes and do not constitute a stability or positivity theorem.

coefficient_scale_contract.conformal_scale: LambdaConf=Mpl sqrt[s/(2(1-2s))], shared by the new cubic and amplitude-quartic operators
coefficient_scale_contract.interpretation: These are canonically normalized engineering coefficient scales. Their minimum is not a physical cutoff, partial-wave unitarity bound, loop-control proof, strong-coupling theorem, or UV completion.

endpoint_and_hierarchy_contract.high_s: With epsilon=1/2-s, LambdaDerivative~(2/5)^(1/4)Lambda0 epsilon^(1/4), LambdaConf~Mpl/sqrt(8 epsilon), and LambdaMix~(Mpl Lambda0^2/8)^(1/3); both derivative-to-new-scale ratios approach zero.
endpoint_and_hierarchy_contract.interior: Every displayed scale is finite and positive at every fixed 0<s<1/2 with positive Mpl and Lambda0.
endpoint_and_hierarchy_contract.low_s: For every fixed positive eta, LambdaDerivative~8^(1/4)Lambda0 s^(3/4), LambdaConf~Mpl sqrt(s/2), and LambdaMix~(Mpl Lambda0^2)^(1/3)s^(2/3); LambdaDerivative/LambdaConf and LambdaDerivative/LambdaMix both approach zero.
endpoint_and_hierarchy_contract.non_no_go: This is not an unconditional strong-coupling no-go because real solutions may avoid endpoints and the coupled metric-aether constraints, loops, higher operators, and UV completion are not analyzed.
endpoint_and_hierarchy_contract.result: Restoring the full scalar-only conformal-factor vertices does not repair the endpoint collapse: the derivative scale remains the asymptotic limiter near both endpoints.

full_scalar_expansion_contract.background: constant Einstein-frame Minkowski metric, Ubar^mu=(1,0,0,0), Wbar=0, varphi_bar=0, alpha>0, 0<s<1/2, d_parallel phibar=Mpl a0 s/alpha, Mpl>0, and Lambda0=sqrt(Mpl a0)>0
full_scalar_expansion_contract.exact_density: L=2 Lambda0^4 p(s_total)+exp[-4 alpha pi/Mpl] K(s_total)(d_t pi)^2, with s_total=alpha sqrt[(s/alpha+d_parallel pi/Lambda0^2)^2+|grad_perp pi|^2/Lambda0^4]
full_scalar_expansion_contract.exact_scope: This is the full scalar-field Taylor expansion through fourth perturbative order with g and U fixed on the declared constant patch. It is not the full coupled metric-aether-matter fluctuation action; coefficient gradients, constraints, loops, and fifth and higher orders remain excluded.
full_scalar_expansion_contract.quartic_density: L4=L4_derivative+8 alpha^2 K pi^2 t/Mpl^2-4 alpha^2 K_s pi r t/(Mpl Lambda0^2)
